. Nevertheless, British Rail's successors, amid train operators' outcries, have sought to reclaim the InterCity title.
The Virgin bid for GW might entail a close partnership with the mainnames Group, which purchased British Rail's previous coach-building unit Armark and Lloyds' Operatic and Dramatic Rights last year. The mainmines brand of coaches, originating from the early 19th century, comprised part of the package. Currently owned by the French public transport giant Veolia, it produces small, low-cost coaches meant to operate as part of a local train or bus service.
